create_TimeManager_subclass: create a subclass of TimeManager that implements the abstract update method for custom animation logic
use_tick_to_advance_time: use the tick method to advance the internal time by a delta_t value each frame
use_set_pause_to_toggle: use set_pause to toggle or set the paused state of a TimeManager instance
use_set_time_to_reset: use set_time to reset the internal clock of a TimeManager to a specific value
use_get_time_to_read: use get_time to read the current internal time in seconds from a TimeManager instance
